english: So, our paths cross again.
It seems I owe you my life.
No.  I always pay my debts.
Once again, I'm in your debt.
You know how this works.
Until I've paid back what I owe, you'll never be rid of me.
What have you done?
Lord Kenji!  Look!
Reinforcements from below - we're trapped!
Come out of there, you!
Don't move!
Thank heavens!  You've saved us!
Help us, please!
Look!  The Wolf clan!
The first key to the shale gate...
That's two.
Ah!  Now we can open the gate!
Going somewhere?
Go if you like, but it's the Lotus clan's day to trade, and they're not too friendly to outsiders.
If I were you, I'd come back tomorrow when the Wolf clan's in town.
Lord Garrin.
No one's seen him for months.
He speaks through his messenger Vetkin these days.
Skulking about somewhere, no doubt.
Going somewhere?
I wouldn't if I were you.
It's the Wolf clan's day to trade, and they're in a frisky mood.
Lord Garrin.
Titles are easy to come by these days.
I'm listening.
They're such pretty things.
Save us!
Help!  We need help here!
We have been waiting for you, Lord Oja.
As we served the father, so we'll serve the son.
The dragon points the way.
A Dragon Warrior must learn the skills of both a spearman and an archer.
Send your spearmen to the archery range.
Send your archers to the dojo.
Run!  Shinja's men are coming!
Do what you will.
He goes to take the ancestral keep from the false Serpent.
The Wolf clan marches to join him.
I would die a hundred deaths for Otomo!
Please, help us!
Lord Shinja has taken all our horses!
Without them, we'll starve when winter comes!
The market's further north.
Figures.  Garrin's always favored those foreigners over his own people.
He's changed.
He stays locked up in that house of his and sends Vetkin to do his dirty work.
Look!  They're attacking the Lotus!
Look there!  Vetkin rides for the Wolf clan!
Look!  It's Kenji!
We are yours to command, Lord!
Run!  It's The Butcher!
Run - The Butcher is attacking!
Wait...don't attack!
We will do your bidding if you will protect us!
Where is that cursed Vetkin?
For six months he's kept me chained in my own cellar - but no longer!
Lord Dragon?
Of course!
I'll be right with you as soon as I rid my town of these interlopers!
What's this?
Vetkin, you worm!
Turn on me after all I've done for you!
We are in your debt, Lord Dragon.
chinese: 神龙大人，多谢你的帮助。

english: Thief?
chinese: 贼？

english: No.  It's where it's always been.
chinese: 不，它一直在老地方。

english: It's in Serpentholm.
chinese: 它在 Serpentholm。

english: And once they'd finished their filthy business, I hid the Orb in the courtyard pool.
chinese: 等他们办完那些见不得人的事，我就把宝珠藏进了庭院的水池。

english: Only the wisest turn over the same stone twice.
chinese: 只有最明智的人，才会把同一块石头移开两次。

english: It's safe where it is.
chinese: 它待在那里很安全。

english: It's at Serpentholm.
chinese: 它在 Serpentholm。

english: And after they'd finished their filthy business, I hid the Orb in the courtyard pool.
chinese: 等他们办完那些见不得人的事，我就把宝珠藏进了庭院的水池。

english: Only the wisest turn over the same stone twice.
chinese: 只有最明智的人，才会把同一块石头移开两次。

english: We thought you dead, honorable prince.
chinese: 尊贵的王子，我们以为你已经死了。

english: Look there!
chinese: 看那边！

english: More are on the way.  They come seeking the Orb.
chinese: 还有更多人正在赶来。他们是冲着宝珠来的。

english: Kenji...we thought you were dead.
chinese: 健治……我们以为你已经死了。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: More are coming - look there!
chinese: 还有人来了——看那边！

english: Welcome back, honorable Prince.
chinese: 欢迎归来，尊贵的王子。

english: My name is Yumi.
chinese: 我叫 Yumi。

english: I will be your guide as you reacquaint yourself with your homeland.
chinese: 我会带你重新熟悉自己的故土。

english: Much has changed since you left and the road to restoration will be long indeed.
chinese: 你离开后，这里发生了许多变化，重建之路也会十分漫长。

english: Someone awaits your arrival in the clearing to the North.
chinese: 北面的空地上有人在等你。

english: Let's meet them and start rebuilding your empire.
chinese: 我们去见他们，然后开始重建你的帝国。

english: Before we can move, we'll have to select Kenji.
chinese: 出发前，先选中健治。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: Left-click Kenji to select him.
chinese: 左键点击健治，选中他。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: Good!
chinese: 很好！

english: Now that he's selected, Right-click where you want him to go and he'll walk there.
chinese: 选中他后，在目的地点击右键，他就会走过去。

english: If you want to unselect Kenji, Left-click something else or Left-click the ground.
chinese: 要取消选中健治，就左键点击别的对象或地面。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: We've arrived.
chinese: 我们到了。

english: This was once peaceful Issen village.
chinese: 这里曾是宁静的 Issen 村。

english: Do you remember it?
chinese: 你还记得这里吗？

english: It used to be one of our most beautiful towns, but the Lotus destroyed it five years ago.
chinese: 它曾是我们最美的村镇之一，但 5 年前被莲花族摧毁了。

english: This Peasant, Sperri, has been waiting for your return.
chinese: 这位农民叫 Sperri，一直在等你回来。

english: He's eager to serve you and rebuild his town.
chinese: 他很想为你效力，重建自己的村庄。

english: Select him.
chinese: 选中他。

english: Left-clicking someone selects them, remember?
chinese: 还记得吗？左键点击一个人就能选中他。

english: Sperri can only build the buildings you see at the bottom of the screen.
chinese: Sperri 只能建造屏幕下方显示的建筑。

english: As you can see, he can only build a Peasant Hut right now.
Left-click on the Peasant Hut icon, then place the hut by right-clicking somewhere on the ground.
chinese: 左键点击农舍图标，再在地面上选一处位置点击右键，建造农舍。

english: If you decide you don't want to build the Hut right now, Left-click to cancel or to select something else.
You can only build on relatively flat terrain, so plan carefully, my Lord.
Excellent, the hut is complete!
Remember, Left-click always selects and Right-click always performs actions.
To continue building the hut, select your Peasant and Right-click on the framework we've already started.
Look!  A new peasant has emerged from the hut we built.
Peasants appear from within the huts automatically.
Your village can only support a certain number of people at a time, indicated in the lower left corner of the screen.
Also, the bigger your current population is the slower the Peasant birthrate will be.
If you watch the bar at the bottom left of the screen, you can tell when the next peasant will arrive.
When the bar is full, a Peasant will appear.
Do you see the golden Peasant button in the center interface?
This is the Idle Peasant button.
It will help you keep our Peasants busy and productive.
Left-clicking it will focus on an idle peasant and automatically select him.
Try it sometime.
If we're to grow, your people will need more food, my lord.
Whenever we construct a building or train a soldier we'll need food and drink to fuel the effort.
Let's harvest some rice from this rice field over here.
Let's select all of our Peasants.
Move the cursor near the Peasants.
Press and hold the left mouse button.
As you move the mouse, you will see a box expand from the cursor.
Drag the cursor until the box encompasses all of the Peasants.
Release the mouse button and the Peasants will be selected.
You can select any of your people in this manner.
This will be crucial to commanding your army effectively, so learn it well.
Now, scroll to the rice field and Right-click on one of the rice plants in the field.
This will tell the Peasants to start harvesting, and they will continue to do so until told differently.
Rice is important, but our people will also need fresh water to drink.
A pond or stream like this one should do nicely.
Select our Peasants, then scroll to the pond and Right-click it.
Excellent!
chinese: 太好了！

english: We're almost ready to start building our army!
chinese: 我们很快就能开始组建军队了！

english: To train warriors, we'll need a Dojo.
chinese: 训练战士需要一座道场。

english: Select some Peasants.
chinese: 选中几名农民。

english: Notice the Dojo is now available in the build menu.
chinese: 看，建造菜单中已经可以选择道场了。

english: We'll find a good spot and build the Dojo just like we built the Peasant Hut.
chinese: 找个合适的位置，像建农舍那样建起道场。

english: The more peasants we have selected the faster our new Dojo will be completed.
chinese: 选中的农民越多，道场建成得就越快。

english: Also, if you hold the right mouse button down and drag left and right we can rotate the building.
chinese: 按住鼠标右键左右拖动，还能旋转建筑。

english: When you let go of the button, the building will be placed.
chinese: 松开鼠标右键，就能放置建筑。

english: My lord, we must complete our Dojo.
chinese: 大人，我们得把道场建好。

english: Select some Peasants and Right-click on the Dojo you started to complete it.
chinese: 选中几名农民，右键点击未完工的道场，完成建造。

english: Now we'll train our first warrior, a Spearman.
Training a Spearman will cost you rice and water.
Uh oh! We're out of rice!
And look, the fields are dry!
Don't worry, my lord - we can harvest more rice if we water the field.
Select some peasants like we did before.
In the lower right corner of the build interface you'll see the blue Water Rice icon.
Left-click the Water Rice icon, and Right-click one of the depleted rice plants.
In no time the field will be ready for harvesting again - go ahead and tell a Peasant to harvest rice.
Well done! The fields are fertile again and our rice stores have been replenished.
Looks like we'll need some more water, though.
Select a Peasant and order him to harvest some water for us, my lord.
Now, back to training that Spearman…
Select a peasant and Right-click on the Dojo.
This will command the Peasant to enter and train in that building.
Your first soldier will be ready soon, my Lord.
You can see how long the training will take by Left-clicking the building and looking at the growing blue line.
Congratulations!
Having learned the economic basics, it's time to learn more about building our army.
Rest up and we'll continue tomorrow.
Welcome back.
As you can see, New Issen is coming along nicely.
If we're to protect our new town, we'll need more than one Spearman.
While you were away the townspeople built a new training building, the Target Range.
Like the Dojo, the Target Range can train Peasants into new fighters.
Instead of Spearman, however, Peasants will become skilled Archers.
...But what would happen if a Spearman were to train on the Target Range?
Select the Spearman and order him to train in the Target Range and let's see what happens.
Very interesting, indeed.
This is a Dragon Warrior, a soldier trained in both hand-to-hand and missile combat.
While he prefers to fight with his sword, he can fire magical bolts as well, making him a most versatile ally.
We call the process of training in multiple buildings 'Unit Alchemy.'
There are certain to be other buildings to train in, so experiment with different training combinations.
In theory you could train the fiercest of all warriors by training one peasant in three different buildings…!
It's important to have a good mix of warriors in our ranks because each type has different strengths and weaknesses.
We'll need to train different soldiers to adapt to our army to a variety of battle conditions.
One last thing, for now.
This is Sparrow's Song, the bathhouse I trained in.
We Geisha are skilled in many arts, but our healing abilities are the most important to you.
To produce another Geisha, send this Peasant into the Bathhouse.
What...?
Don't be silly, of course not!
That Peasant will take over the duties of one of the Geisha trainees inside, allowing her to emerge and aid you on the battlefield.
Excellent!
Good day, sister Yukako!
Unlike other clansmen, healers cannot enter other training buildings.
Likewise, our troops cannot enter the Bathhouse.
Let's rest until morning, my Lord - today's been easy enough, but tomorrow…
...Tomorrow you'll learn about combat, my most exciting lecture.
Until then…
Wake up, my Lord!
We're under attack, but where are they?
Do you see the small crossed swords icon in the center of the interface?
If you Left-click that you will be moved to any active battles that involve our forces.
Cannoneers!
And that fellow with the torch…it's a Raider!
We trained some new Dragon Warriors overnight, and they await your orders!
Quick, back to our forces!
Do you see the small map in the bottom right corner of the screen?
If you Left-click on that our view will instantly be moved to any location on the map.
The small orange dots represent our clansmen and the small red dots represent the enemy.
Left-click on the orange dots on the minimap to move back to our forces.
Select the Dragon Warriors, quickly!
You can tell your soldiers to run by double Right-clicking on the enemy.
You can also hold down the Alt key when you Right-click to command soldiers to run.
Everything's…gone.
So many are dead…
Please, let's try this again…
We're saved!
The people thank you, Lord.
Did you notice the Cannoneer couldn't fire his cannon when our warriors engaged him?
Most ranged attackers are much less effective in hand-to-hand combat.
This means that engaging them in melee combat is a good way to disable them.
Likewise, you should keep your own missile-using soldiers from engaging in melee combat.
Our Dragon Warriors have fought hard protecting us tonight, so I'll retire them for the evening.
Hopefully we won't need them any more tonight.
...What?
It would seem that I spoke too soon - Fire!
Quick, we must douse the fire!
That damned raider must have done this.
A burning building gradually breaks down.
The fiercer the flames, the faster it will burn down.
Do you see the small fire icon in the center of the interface?
Left-click it to instantly focus on the the burning building!
Oh no! Sparrow's Song is burning!
Don't worry sisters, we'll save you!
Look, a Peasant!
Select the Peasant and move the cursor over the burning building - notice the cursor changes to the 'Extinguish' cursor.
Right-click to confirm the order and your Peasant will move to extinguish these buildings.
The Peasant firefighter will gather from the nearest source of water and automatically return to douse the flames.
Even the hottest infernos can be quelled with only a few buckets of water.
Whew, that was close!
We were lucky there was a pond nearby.
To deal with fires more effectively, build towns near ponds or other sources of water.
My lord, may I humbly ask you to repair Sparrow's Song?
Please select the heroic Peasant that saved my home.
At the bottom of the interface you'll see a blue icon with a hammer icon on it.
This is the 'Repair' command.
Please select the Repair command and Right-click on the bathhouse.
Oh thank you, my lord!
I don’t think my sisters and I can ever thank you enough for your generosity.
Now we should think about New Issen's future…
My lord, I apologize for asking such an unreasonable request - please forgive me and we'll move on.
Oh dear, we didn't put it out in time…
Fortunately, all of my sisters got away safely.
Nothing in this life is permanent - there will always be other bathhouses, I suppose.
It's time we built some town defenses to prevent raids like that from happening again.
Select a Peasant.
If you look at the interface you'll see that we can now build Watchtowers.
Watchtowers are formidable defenses, but we can only support so many.
As our town grows and gains certain structures we will be able to support additional Watchtowers.
Let's build a Watchtower.
While we wait for the Watchtower to be completed, we should use the time to train an Archer.
You see, Watchtowers must be manned by soldiers to be effective.
Also, they're most useful to missile units, such as the Archer.
Excellent.
Select the new Archer and Right-click on our new Watchtower.
Once in the Watchtower, the Archer will not only be defended but also gain increased attack strength, range and sight.
Good!
In addition to their other strengths, each Watchtower has a special ability of its own.
Left-click our new Watchtower to select it.
Look in the bottom left corner of the interface.
Dragon Watchtowers use the Daze ability, but our intelligence shows that other clans' are different.
The ability can only be used when the Watchtower is charged with enough spiritual power.
This power is indicated by the Charge meter in next to the ability's activation button.
With your base defenses in order, we should strike against the enemy now.
Our scouts report that the enemies are attacking from this location.
Aha!
They made a tactical mistake!
They built their town at the base of a cliff, something we can use to our advantage.
If we attack from higher ground we will surely win!
From higher ground our attacks are stronger and we'll be defended from the enemy's assaults, just like in our Watchtowers.
Train three Archers and we'll run these scoundrels out of this province for good!
Excellent Lord, our assault team is ready!
Move our troops to the location indicated on the minimap and attack!
Excellent, the enemy has been routed!
Their hut still remains, though, and our arrows aren't very effective against buildings…
Perhaps we can crush it with these boulders on the hill?
Select one of your Archers and Right-click a boulder to push it.
The boulder will roll in the direction it is pushed, so line the Archer up with the building to push it in the right direction.
This province is finally free of those enemy scum!
Hmmm, we're out of boulders…
I guess we have no other choice - we will have to use our arrows.
This will take longer, but ultimately we will prevail.
So much happened today, and the town is still in shambles.
Please rest for tomorrow's training, my lord.
You did well and we must rebuild the town.
Until then, rest well.
Ah, much better - the town is repaired and the people can return to their daily lives.
With New Issen secure, it's time we started freeing other provinces from our enemies.
...but we're not ready for such an assault.
Let me help you prepare your forces for the coming battles.
There's much you can do to modify and improve your army's effectiveness in battle.
The most basic is mounting.
Most soldiers can ride horses into battle and get considerable advantages in battle when they do so.
Let's try giving a horse to a soldier, shall we?
Here are the Stables.
This building will domesticate wild horses and make them battle-ready.
But where do we get wild horses?
Ah, it looks like this peasant has found some.
Wild horses will always be visible on the minimap as brown dots, so keep an eye out for them.
Select him and Right-click on a horse to begin the herding process.
Befriending wild horses is not an easy task.
Once befriended, the horse will follow your peasant back to the stables.
Now that the horse has been domesticated, let's mount it.
Select this Spearman and Right-click on the Stables.
Excellent.
From atop a horse units are more resilient to melee attacks and inflict more damage in battle.
In addition, horse-using clans train these steeds with an additional attack of their own.
Select the Spearman you just mounted.
See the button underneath his portrait?
When this button is pressed, it will initiate the horse's Trample ability.
Trample deals considerable damage to any enemies that surround the horse, but will deplete some of its stamina.
Stamina is represented by the blue bar underneath each soldier's green health bar
When any soldier runs or uses an ability he will consume stamina.
Trample is effective both offensively and defensively, but your horse won't be able to run as long afterwards, so use it carefully.
Peasants can also use horses.
While they don't mount them, they can use them as packhorses to efficiently carry more resources to the Peasant Huts.
Finally, a soldier can dismount by selecting it and Left-clicking the ""Dismount"" button in the lower right portion of the interface.
That's about all there is to know about horses, my lord.
The second type of enhancement is called 'BattleGear.'
One moment, my lord…
Please give me a moment to catch my breath…
BattleGear enhance soldiers by giving them additional powers.
For example, an Archer is typically an effective anti-infantry soldier…
…But a certain BattleGear will allow him to shoot fiery arrows to destroy buildings.
The Dragon Clan gains BattleGear by training in certain buildings, but other clans may have entirely different approaches.
Select the Dragon Warrior and order him to enter the Shrine.
The Dragon Warrior is meditating inside the shrine, unlocking a power deep within himself to use in battle.
Excellent - your Dragon Warrior has gained the ability to use the 'Chi Shield.'
Now let's try using it - select the Dragon Warrior.
Do you see the  new button underneath the Dragon Warrior's portrait?
Left-click it and see what happens.
You've activated the Chi Shield.
While active, the Dragon Warrior outwardly focuses his life force to protect himself.
The concentration needed to maintain the Chi Shield renders him immobile, but he is completely impervious to damage.
As a diversionary measure, the Chi Shield is unparalleled.
Notice that his stamina is steadily depleting.
The Chi Shield can be turned off whenever you wish, but will automatically dissipate when the Dragon Warrior's stamina is depleted.
Not all BattleGear use stamina.
Some have unlimited use, some have strict limitations and some even consume the user's health.
For more information a BattleGear's function, place your cursor over the button and check the tooltip on the left side of the screen.
Each warrior type gets different abilities from the BattleGear buildings, so experiment and try training a variety of units.
On to the final improvement type.
During the previous battles, you were blessed with some points of Yang.
These tokens of spiritual power are earned through battle.
The better our forces fight the faster we'll earn them.
As a noble and enlightened clan, we received points of Yang.
These are denoted by the white tokens to the left of the interface's central Yin Yang icon.
Darker clans, like our Serpent attackers, accrue black tokens of Yin.
Once acquired, we can focus Yang to improve our forces' battle prowess.
Select the Dojo by Left-clicking it.
My lord, this is the Target Range.
The Dojo is the building on the left.
Please select the Dojo so you can continue to learn about techniques.
You'll notice on the right side of the interface two icons.
Each of these is a 'Technique,' an enhancement purchased with Yin or Yang.
Unlike BattleGear, which only improves an individual, Techniques upgrade entire ranks of soldiers!
By moving your mouse over these icons you can read the effects of the technique in the tooltip on the left side of the screen.
Begin learning one of these techniques by Left-clicking its icon.
I suppose there's no harm in learning one of the Target Range's techniques, my lord.
Good.
While a training building's masters meditate on the chosen technique they will be unable to admit new trainees, so plan ahead.
Excellent!
All existing Spearmen have become stronger and all future Spearmen will benefit, as well.
Effective use of Techniques can give you the edge over your opponent.
Use them wisely to complement your existing strategy.
With upgrades out of the way, we've completed your training.
Reflect on what you've learned today.
If you forget something and would like to go through these lessons again, I'd be honored to review them with you.
My lord?
Is everything all right?
Let's continue with your training, my lord.
I'll repeat what I said, in case you forgot.
My lord, we should act quickly.
My lord, the unit is needed over here.
Your dragon is...cryptic.
What's that?
Otomo!  Who did this?
Kenji!  Lotus soldiers!
How did they get past Serpentholm?
If we circle around, we can avoid them.
I was hoping you'd say that.
If I squint just right, I can already see Shinja's head on a pike.
But...the Serpent's ancestral seat...
They're finished.  The Lotus has beaten them.
Can we trust them?
There's still the Lotus to fight.  Look here.
The Lotus crushed the last Wolf resistance in the mountains.
They now control all the high ground and the richest mining regions.
They haven't moved on these provinces yet.
The Lotus clan's victory over the Wolf has made them bold.
It's only a matter of time before they attack the monasteries.
The holy brothers would be valuable allies.
Hmph!  I've never trusted those assassins.
They'd betray us as soon as the gold ran out.
Then how shall we proceed?
We'll have to take the bridges if we want to cross the river.
The river's low.  We can get the men across.
What's that?
But you said the Orb doesn't matter.
All hail the Dragon!
<Groan>  Huh...?
What's going on here?
Get away from her!
Did your dragon do all this?
Soul Flame?
Cut the other bridge - we'll seal them on the High Plateau!
If we hadn't cut the bridges, the Lotus would have taken the monastery.
I am Kenji of the Serpent clan, and my ancestor broke the world.
chinese: 我是灵蛇族的健治。我的祖先曾令世界分崩离析。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: The Horde was destroying everything in its path, so he gathered the clan and fled south, saving what little he could.
chinese: Horde 所到之处尽成废墟，他便率领族人南逃，尽力保住仅存的一切。

english: But when they got to the High Plateau, there was nowhere left to run.
chinese: 可当他们抵达高原时，前方已无路可逃。

english: Tarrant died without knowing what his choice to stay behind truly meant.
chinese: Tarrant 至死也不知道，留下来的抉择究竟意味着什么。

english: He didn't know that the Horde would be only the first of many enemies to plague the Serpent clan.
chinese: 他不知道 Horde 只是灵蛇族日后众多祸患中的第一个。

english: He couldn't know that without the Orb's power to guide them, his descendents would be weak and wicked.
chinese: 他更不可能知道，失去宝珠的指引，后代会变得软弱而邪恶。

english: Did he ever truly have a choice?
chinese: 他真的有过选择吗？

english: It's been a long time, Otomo.
Don't call me that.
That blade has been my burden for seven years.
If you're so eager to avenge the Serpent, pick it up.
Pick it up!
The bandits worked for Shinja?
Shinja served my father loyally for years.
Would he meet with me?
I didn't come back to repeat my father's mistakes.
I'm going to need Shinja.
It's over.
You know who I am.
Where is the Serpent's Orb?
You were charged with protecting the Orb.
Where is it?
No - he would have.
How has the Swan's Pool survived?
Show me the safest path.
I didn't want this.
This land never changes.
They've had a lot of practice.
If it's not us driving them into the ground, it's their warlock masters.
For now.
You mean you'll rule.
Not the way father fights it.
There must be a better way.
I'm not my father, Otomo.
Not many.
Does it matter?
No.
If we push on, we can reach the Swan's Pool by dusk.
The thief...why was he here?
I have.
Did he get the Serpent's Orb?
I've no time for riddles, woman.
No.  We'll go to Serpentholm.
I've no quarrel with the other clans.
You've seen the Orb.  It's real.
If it's to be done, let's do it quickly.
Let's teach this upstart clan a lesson.
I see it.
It's not the Lotus clan.
When the Orb wakes, so does the Dragon.
He's telling us to hurry.
It's not called the Dragon's Spire for nothing.
Keep the men moving.
We won't stop again tonight.
Serpentholm.
It's the Orb they're after, not me.
The key to Serpentholm.
I made new friends while I was away.
Where are you, Serpent?
Show yourself, old man!
You'll not hide behind your geisha tonight!
Whether I'm second son or tenth, I'll make you hear me!
Wake up!
(gasps)
And the one who stole the Orb?
But you lost him.
I know.
It's what killed the Serpent.
It doesn't matter anymore.
Look.
The Dragon and the Orb are one.
You never looked.
It's not.
The Orb was only half of Tarrant's power.
No.
I have to go to the Dragon's Spire.
No.  I need you here.
Let Shinja contain the Lotus and Wolf if he can.
I seek the Serpent's Orb.
The thief was not of the Lotus.
Tarrant used the Orb to break the world.
But...
The land must be healed.
Without the Orb, how do I repair the damage my clan has done?
What evil?
Wait...where will I find you?
The dragon's time is over.
We shouldn't have gone to him.
Shinja.
Cut him down.
We've been betrayed.
No.  The village nearby will help us.
The Lotus will find no friends here.
We stay and fight.
Sorry, old friend.
Make it happen.
Kazan!
Burn Serpentholm.  Burn it to the ground.
There is no Serpent.
There's only the Dragon.
Wolf refugees.
Give them food and house them in the supply tents.
The Wolf clan isn't the enemy any more.
Even in my father's time, those lands were independent.
The plateaus to the east are holy ground and the western province was granted to the ninja.
The monks and ninja were always fighting, and my father sought to separate them.
If we align ourselves with the monks, the ninja will turn on us.
The ninja once served the Lotus, and might know their secrets.
True...and if we enlist the ninja, we can be certain the monks will join the Lotus.
No closer, Zymeth.
Long gone.
Where is my father's most trusted advisor?
Why the flag of truce?
The Orb is meaningless.
Ask your friend.
I know that if he doesn't kill you, I will.
You're wasting your time.
It's begun.
The Lotus are using the Orb to rid themselves of corruption.
The Dragon was right.
Their belief gives it power.
We have to hurry.
I am Kenji, Lord of the Dragon clan.
For years, his descendants cowered behind their stone walls, hating each other and fearing the dark.
They never understood that even in the very heart of Serpentholm, shadows lurked in every corner.
The darkness will always be out there, trying to make us afraid.
But we'll hide no longer.
We face the future a united land.
It's time to make the shadows afraid.
No.
The Serpent is dead.
What if I am?
Would you betray your lord so casually?
Shinja and Otomo fight each other?
Why do my father's lap dogs tear at the scraps of his empire?
True...the peasants are an ill-mannered bunch, in need of schooling.
And Shinja and Otomo are weaklings, not fit to rule.
Submit or I'll take your head.
You know who I am.
Why did you keep fighting?
You were both Serpent men.
Now you're both mine, or you're both dead.
You were charged with protecting Tarrant's Orb.
Where is it?
You gave the sacred orb to the geisha?
Curse that wretched old man!
The Serpent was a fool.
The Lotus were always jealous of the Orb's power.
The old taboos won't last much longer.
We must move quickly.
The Swan's Pool is here, to the north.
The most direct route is straight through Riverside.
Glorious.
Like old times...
We should have killed them all when we had the chance.
My brother was right.
Where have you been?
My homes.  Their fields, their livestock, their daughters, their sons - all mine.
This is Serpent land.
There are worse men to be.
Get the troops moving.
If we push on, we can reach the Swan's Pool by dusk.
Give me Tarrant's Orb.
It will be safer in my hands.
Are you mad?
So you saw him too.
Don't they understand who I am?
No.
We hit them, hard and fast.
Execute the loudmouthed one and bring the rest.
Quickly.
Good.
Let them fight each other while we take what is ours.
Never question me again.
The key to victory.
I made some new friends while I was away.
And the Orb?
You are useless.
That creature killed my father, and you let him escape.
I've no more time to waste.
I must have the Orb if I am to rule.
We'll leave a garrison at Serpentholm.
The thief is headed north.
No doubt he seeks an alliance with the Lotus or Wolf.
I will take the main army north into these provinces and make sure he finds only corpses to befriend.
These lands were once loyal to the Serpent.
They must be brought back under control.
Shinja, take your men south toward the Dragon's Spire and pacify the villages along the way.
Burn them to the ground if they resist.
Otomo will follow behind and clean up the surviving rabble.
If they're loyal, they have nothing to fear from me.
I kill to make the clan stronger.
I carve away the fat and save the lean.
I won't tolerate cowards or shirkers.
Which one are you, Otomo?
Then do what I say.
Watch him.
Since the Lotus were beaten at the Swan's Pool, they have lost every battle.
Finishing them here, before they retreat to their keep, would put an end to them once and for all.
The barbarous Wolf clan is still strong here, around the mines.
A head-on assault would be costly, but would deprive the Wolf of their armories.
On the other hand, if I take the men through the swamps here, we might outflank the Wolf.
They would be forced to shift troops to counter, weakening them on other fronts.
Pull, damn you!
That's twice now.
Set an example.
You're one of Otomo's men.
By Otomo?
And Shinja?  Where's Shinja?
To your posts!
Otomo, Otomo, Otomo...
Why are you so eager to die?
I would have let you live another year, perhaps even two.
Not bad.
And Otomo's head?
Good.
This necromancer you found...can he be trusted?
Then he'll be loyal for a while yet.
Look here.
The scouts report that the Wolf have burned the Lotus keep to the ground.
They still control all the high ground and the mining regions.
The monks have held the eastern plateaus for years.
And my father gave the western swamps to the ninja to keep them far away from holy ground.
The ninja once served the Lotus, and the Wolf have not forgotten it.
Their peasants are superstitious and are deathly afraid of the assassins.
If the ninja joined our cause, we would be unstoppable.
Perhaps.
They keep to themselves and never much cared for my father.
Wait.
Now.
No.  Look there.
The Wolf protect my father's killer.
No truce, no quarter.
They're trying to use the Orb.
They're trying to go home.
If they remake the world, they can escape to the continent.
You'll have your fill tonight, Dead One.
Your time is past.
You don't belong here.
I am Kenji, Lord of the Serpent clan, and my ancestor broke the world.
For two centuries, my people hid, praying for the Dragon's protection.
But the Dragon was only a myth.
The meek and useless are all gone now.
The last of the cowards died with the traitor Otomo.
We are purified at last.
It's time to make the shadows afraid.
Left-click me to select me.
chinese: 左键点击我，选中我。

english: After I am selected, right-click on the ground and I will move.
chinese: 选中我后，右键点击地面，我就会移动。

english: Alternatively, right-click on an enemy and I will attack.
chinese: 或者，右键点击敌人，我就会攻击。

english: Left-click something else if you want to deselect me.
chinese: 想取消选中我，就左键点击别处。

english: After him!
It's either you or Shinja - your choice.
Don't make me ask.
Where’s Shinja?
Do you really value his life over yours?
Strip their corpses.
Would Shinja kill his own men?
Then fetch their clothes.
Forget it.
Lord Oja was my father.
How did you know where I was?
We need to pass through town.
Who lives on the hill?
Ah...General Garrin.  Is he well?
Where is this Vetkin?
We were told to stay away while the Lotus clan's in town.
That doesn't sound like the Garrin I know.
Cleaned up the trash.
Garrin.
Garrin!
You remember me?
Who has done this?
Then the Lotus has an enemy.
It can't be!
The Lotus knew what it meant to build a village this close to the Spire.
I seek your wisdom, ancient one.
I know.
I'm not my father.
I want to heal the damage my family has done to the land.
I want to end this war.
I can do it if you'll help me.
You knew there was a ninja there?
You should have warned us!
Are you one of them?
Will you take us to this Soul Flame?
The Lotus have something that belongs to my family.
You're going to help me get it back.
It's been too long, good brother.
Then we'll have to hurry.
Gather the rest of the monks and be ready to fight.
Is there another way to cross to the High Plateau from here?
I know.
They'll be ready for us now.
What are you?
You and your kind died centuries ago!
Tarrant killed you!
Hunt him down!
It's been a long time, Otomo.
Why are you attacking Shinja's men?
The peasants of the southern provinces should obey him.
He is captain of the Serpent guard.
So you rebelled.
Your whimpering sickens me.
Lead me to Shinja, and I will try to forget this nauseating conversation.
Shinja.
Why?
How odd.
He's still able to pay his other mercenaries.
I found this box of jewels in the camp of the raiders to the northwest.
If you'll work for me, they're yours.
Then you can be twice as loyal to me as you were to Shinja.
Talk or die.
You may as well talk.  If I don't kill you, Shinja will.
I have business with Shinja.
Does Shinja pay you enough to die for him?
No, Arah - I won't have you following me again.
I thought I'd shaken you for good.
Through your town.
Who owns the house on the hill?
Feeble old Garrin?
He calls himself a Lord now?
So it seems.
But money...ah, money is what truly makes a man.
Perhaps even several men.
Men who might refuse to fight for Garrin if anything were to...happen.
Valuable, too.
Share them with your fellows.
The Serpent walks where he likes.
This was once Serpent land.
I reclaim it.
If you like.
Or you could fight for me instead.
When I sit on the Serpent's throne, the faithful will be well rewarded.
Name it.
That could be arranged.
You die today, Otomo!
Wait!
I want to talk to you!
Soul Flame?
We'll protect your flame.
Good, because I have a task for you.
Better.
Come - let's skin the rest of these scruffy wolves.
This is my ground.
Or have you forgotten the Serpent clan already?
You monks serve me now.
Oh, but it will.
Take them!
I didn't...
Where's your holy ground now?
Let me 'enlighten' you, brother.
Your holy ground is where I walk and where I sleep.
I am your holy ground, and you will hold me as dear as you did that pile of rubble over there.
Do you hear me?
Then gather your brothers.
There's still much to do.
To the altar!
Get to the Orb at all costs!
You fool - you don't know what you've done!
Then die!
What are you?
I'm not afraid of the dark.
Beautiful, isn't it?
The sands of time flow at our whim.
Why do you still resist us?
You too will come to this in time...
Send the golems, Soban!
Detonate them, or I'll...
I am Zymeth's second, and you'll do as I say!
Calm yourself.  I'm alone.
I won't, but I'm afraid I can't speak for my friends.
Another time, another place!
Sweep this rabble aside and find the Orb!
Another time, another place!
Please...please, stop!
This is madness - the Lotus clan is worthless.
It's clear you're destined to rule.
Let me serve the Serpent clan!
Lord Zymeth...
It's beautiful, Lord.
The Wolf clan has retreated to their keep.
An Oja leads the army.
It's the second son - Kenji.
The one they called the Dragon.
I...I don't have it...
Serpent scum!
The scroll!  I have the scroll!
Begone - your clan's time is over!
I won't!
The golems aren't warriors, Koril!
No, no, a thousand times no!
I'll not sacrifice my little ones to Zymeth's mad schemes!
I'd sooner join the Serpent!
That's it!
I'm through with you and your wretched clan!
Shh.
Look.
It won't be so pretty once the Diseased Ones are through with it.
You have news.
Good.
It's only a matter of time before they serve us again.
And what is this I hear of peasants marching under the Serpent banner?
That's impossible.
I saw their corpses burn.
And where is his head?
He angered me.
You didn't tell me you'd left one of Oja's sons alive.
You're doing this?
Some of my people don't care for you.
Some...
Just the same, I like you.
You brought me the Serpent's Orb.
Of course it does.
We owe you much...
Gone so soon?
You've grown up.
Where's the young pup I once caught sulking behind the curtains in the Serpent's throne room?
Also gone.
Perhaps we've both grown up, Kenji.
If you want to live, the war ends here.
The Orb is ours.
You know him?
I'm giving you a chance to walk away, boy.
Your clan died with your father.
This is Lotus land now.
At last - free of corruption!
Now I am whole!
You're too late, Serpent!
The Lotus would die rather than bow to your kind again!
Kenji!
chinese: 健治！
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: We thought you were dead.
chinese: 我们以为你死了。

english: I've waited seven years to serve you, Lord Oja.
chinese: Oja 大人，我等了七年，只希望能为你效力。

english: He saved our lives!
chinese: 他救了我们的命！

english: He doesn't speak for the village.
chinese: 他不能代表整个村子说话。

english: The Serpent's Son will take tea in my house.
chinese: 灵蛇之子，请到我家坐坐。

english: He rules the provinces to the north, and would rule this one too if he could.
chinese: 他统治着北方的行省；若有机会，也会统治这里。

english: He seeks to rebuild the clan, but his methods are...questionable.
chinese: 他想重建氏族，但他的方法……令人质疑。

english: He's tasted power, and won't give it up easily.
chinese: 他已经尝到权力的好处，不会轻易放手。

english: But Shinja only rules because no one else will stand against the other clans.
chinese: 可信蛇能掌权，只因无人敢站出来对抗其他氏族。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: Wolf and Lotus are tearing what's left of your father's empire apart.
chinese: 恶狼族和莲花族正在瓜分你父亲残存的帝国。

english: The people need a leader with Oja blood.
chinese: 人民需要一位拥有 Oja 家族血统的领袖。

english: Then you'll have to beat him.
chinese: 那你就得打败他。

english: Shinja rules two provinces from an old Serpent fort, here.
chinese: 信蛇从这里的一座灵蛇族旧堡垒统治着两个行省。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: His tax collectors take most of what this village has...
chinese: 他派人收走了这个村子的大部分东西……

english: ...while his hired archers haunt the eastern road, stealing what little remains.
chinese: ……雇来的弓箭手又盘踞在东边道路，抢走仅剩的一点。

english: Break Shinja's forces and he'll lose his will to fight.
chinese: 击溃信蛇的部队，他就会失去斗志。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: We have no soldiers, but the villagers stand ready to serve.
chinese: 我们没有士兵，但村民们愿意效力。

english: What shall we do?
chinese: 我们该怎么办？

english: And yet you kept fighting.
chinese: 可你还是坚持战斗。

english: Show respect!
chinese: 放尊重点！

english: Lord Oja would never have given the Orb to geisha!
chinese: Oja 大人绝不会把宝珠交给艺妓！

english: Every death here today saved two.
chinese: 今天这里每牺牲一人，就救下了两人。

english: No one could ask for more.
chinese: 没人能要求更多了。

english: They fight because they fear the Serpent clan.
chinese: 他们作战，是因为惧怕灵蛇族。

english: There are worse men you could be.
chinese: 你本来可能成为更坏的人。

english: Did you kill him?
chinese: 你杀了他吗？

english: Not to me.
chinese: 对我来说不是。

english: You know the legends.
chinese: 你知道那些传说。

english: He's all we have.
chinese: 他是我们唯一的希望。

english: I've never seen anyone move like that.
chinese: 我从未见过有人那样行动。

english: Impossible!  The Lotus clan tore Serpentholm apart stone by stone searching for the Orb!
chinese: 不可能！莲花族为了寻找宝珠，把 Serpentholm 一砖一石都拆了！

english: He's right, Lord.
chinese: 他说得对，大人。

english: If we abandon the villagers, they'll die.
chinese: 如果抛下村民，他们会死。

english: The Orb has been safe for seven years.
chinese: 宝珠已经安然无恙地藏了七年。

english: Only the geisha know where it is.
chinese: 只有艺妓知道它在哪里。

english: Bring them with us, and the Orb stays safe.
chinese: 带上她们，宝珠就能继续安全地藏着。

english: Smoke from the Dragon's Spire.
chinese: 神龙之塔升起了烟。

english: There's a village there.
chinese: 那里有一个村子。

english: If the Lotus soldiers are pillaging that far south, they've already got Serpentholm.
chinese: 如果莲花族士兵已经抢到那么靠南的地方，Serpentholm 恐怕也已失守。

english: What?
The dragon is telling us to hurry.
The other clans have come.
There's a lot of them.
A week ago these men were peasant farmers.
You've made warriors out of them, but the Lotus and Wolf soldiers are veterans.
Better that than seven years spent stealing from the very peasants who trusted us to protect them!
That...what is that?
Gone.
We tried to follow...
Are you sure?
Why does he want the Orb?
Shinja...
Why did I never see that before?
He'll come to his senses, Lord.
Let me go with you.
Kenji said...
No...the Wolf clan is beaten.
The Lotus wizards are the real enemy.
We must not let their army escape back to the high plateau.
Strike them while their backs are to the sea, and we'll finish them once and for all.
I'll live.
If you have something to say...
Kenji will kill you for this.
Show respect!
Even after your father's death, the geisha were thought untouchable...
The Orb may still be safe.
Don't listen to him, lord - this way is the safest.
Even though the Lotus have built an outpost there, the dense woods should mask our passage.
Putting out fires.
This is madness, Kenji.
We've driven these people from their homes.
You sound like your father.
Serpentholm is a ruin.
The Lotus wizards tore it down when the Serpent died.
Kenji, it doesn't matter.
Our enemies thought it was here.
We could push on to Serpentholm.
And the geisha?
What?  We can't...
But lord...they are many and we are few.
Perhaps we should withdraw.
Lost.
We tried to follow...
It wasn't human.  You saw...
You're mad!
Can't you see?
He's turned on his own people!
How many more can you kill before the clan is destroyed?
That's...
I serve the clan.
Please...let me help you start a village.
This is Sperri, one of the peasants you saved in the last province.
Select him.
What you now see at the bottom of the screen are the available buildings.
You can only build a peasant hut right now.
Left-click on the peasant hut icon, then place the hut by right-clicking somewhere on the ground.
chinese: 左键点击农舍图标，再在地面上选一处位置点击右键，建造农舍。

english: If you decide you don't want to build the hut right now, left-click to cancel or to select something else.
You can only build on relatively flat terrain, so plan carefully.
Excellent!
Remember, left-click is always cancel or select, and right-click always performs actions.
Look!  A new peasant has emerged from the hut we built.
Now your people need food.
Let's harvest some rice from that rice field over there.
Rice is the currency of this land and is used in all construction and training efforts.
Left-click one of the peasants, scroll to the rice field and right-click the rice field.
Rice is important indeed, but you’ll also need water.
A pond or stream like that one would do nicely.
Select a peasant, then scroll to the pond and right-click it.
Excellent!  We're almost ready to start building our army!
chinese: 很好！我们就快能组建军队了！

english: To train warriors, we'll need a Dojo.
chinese: 要训练战士，我们需要一座道场。

english: Select a peasant.
chinese: 选中一名农民。

english: Notice the Dojo is now available in the build menu.
chinese: 看，建造菜单中已经可以选择道场了。

english: Find a good spot and build the Dojo just like you built the peasant hut.
chinese: 找个合适的位置，像建农舍那样建起道场。

english: Now to train your first Spearman.
chinese: 现在来训练你的第一名长矛兵。

english: Select a peasant and right-click the Dojo.
chinese: 选中一名农民，右键点击道场。

english: Training Spearmen will cost you rice and water, so make sure some peasants keep harvesting.
chinese: 训练长矛兵要消耗稻米和水，记得让一些农民继续采集。

english: Well done - we're on our way!
chinese: 干得好，我们已经迈出第一步了！

english: The bandits must have driven these people out.
But look - there's a peasant hut still standing!
We should rebuild this village and make it our own.
That's the last of them.
What?
No, but...
My uncle lived in this village.
The Lotus clan.
Look at the forest...how strange.
Kenji...is that you?
You've grown up.
He abuses your father's people.
His tax collectors take everything that's not nailed down, and...
Since your father's death, the clan has fallen apart.
Only to save the peasants from...
As you command.
Shinja's bandits drove these people out.
But look - there's still one peasant hut intact!
With your permission, I will claim it for the clan.
A new peasant has just emerged from the peasant hut.
Select him.
Now you see the buildings the peasant can construct for you.
At the moment, you can only build another peasant hut or a target range.
Left-click the target range icon, then right-click on the ground to place the new building.
You'll need additional rice and water to construct more buildings and train an army.
Select one peasant, then right-click on that rice field west of the village to begin harvesting rice.
There's also a stream to the north where we can obtain fresh water.
Send a peasant there as well.
Now that we have a stockpile of rice and water, we should begin training some archers.
Select a peasant, then right-click the target range.
Excellent!
We must be careful.
The high road is easier travelling, but we're sure to be spotted.
The forest would mask our movements until we're ready to attack.
Come out, you madman!
Face me!
You are your father's son...
I'll give the Wolf miners this much - they know how to run.
Mm.  We have Father to thank for that.
They serve the Lotus, and the Lotus serve us.
The Oja are the only family fit to serve as lords of this land.
The Serpent clan will rule long after father's gone.
Of course - I'm the first-born son!
Besides, you spend every free moment carousing with commoners in back-alley wine shops.
You've no stomach for war.
Yes, always winning is such a burden.
Get off my property!
I bought this plantation from the Wolf clan!
Back to work, cretins!
Our 'guests' were just leaving.
Begone, I say!
You'll pay for that!
Get off my property!
I bought this plantation from the Wolf clan.
Then I'll fight you.
I do not come cheap.
I'd like to...sample...one of your geisha.
Ah...get inside, my pretty, get inside.
Most...persuasive.
You've left me no choice.
Perceptive.
I was sure Kenji would come looking for his clan's precious dragon.
Where is he?
I, the Necromancer.
I can help him.
Don't preach to me, snake man.
Did you enjoy the geisha's screams when you ran her through?
Time's a-wasting.
Already the Wolf have the Orb.
The dead talk to me.
So he's returned to Serpentholm.
Where Kenji goes, fresh corpses litter the ground.
It is...most pleasant.
Lead on, then.
Most pleasant...
Who's that?
Do they know you?
Ah...good...
More friends to play with...
Most pleasant...

She's going to fetch her warriors.
We must rally our comrades in the upper mines. Follow me!
What are you doing down here?
Stop babbling. How many slaves are imprisoned down here?
You're too pathetic to kill. Get out of here.
Did you hear that? We've got to rescue all ten slaves before we escape…
Two warriors freed, eight to go…
That's half of them…we must keep searching!
Just three more Wolf Clansmen to find, and we can leave this pit…
There's only one prisoner left -- now where is he?
That's the last of our captive brothers -- let's head for the upper mines.
Stay alert. Yvaine won't let us escape these depths without a fight!
Longtooth has fallen! Our cause seems hopeless now...
To bring the Lotus down, we'll need the strength of every last Wolf Clansman.
We must break their chains before Yvaine's troops arrive!
Yes, we'll need a Pitch Slinger to burn it away from a safe distance.
I'm surprised there aren't any Pitch Slingers locked up nearby...
Strike that lever, and we'll find out.
It's locked…maybe a Sledger could break down the door.
Our Pitch Slingers should be able to burn that gas away from a distance.
Out of the way. Our business is with the Lotus.
Too many of the Wolf Clan are still in chains.
As long as they remain here, so must I.
But there are other mines, and other slaves. We'll need their help, too.
You must reach the other mines and rally them to war, Longtooth.
I'll stay behind and free the others.
That's why you must spread word of our rebellion.
We'll need all of the Wolf Clan's strength to win.
Then I'll die as a warrior.
I know you won't.
And you're as fat as ever.
Throw off your chains, brothers! Your Clan is at war!
Budo, you swine! You'll pay for this!
My poor, foolish brothers…
I'm sorry I couldn't save you.
Another wall of magic -- but there's no lever!
It must be on the other side…
Maybe a Digger could tunnel beneath this barrier and find the controls.
We've rescued a Digger! We'll be able to tunnel under obstacles now…
A Sledger could break open this cell in no time…
Everyone, run for the exit! We can't let the Lotus trap us here!
Honor, from a Lotus? That would be a first.
My Clan will avenge me!
What…? Yvaine!
She's planning something. I must find another way out!
It looks like this old air-shaft could be opened again.
If only the Sledgers were at my side!
I've never seen this part of the mine before…
It's a hidden Shalery and some workers! Hail, Wolf brothers!
This is a wonderful discovery -- I'll be able to forge armor with these tools.
Excellent! With protection like this, I could take on the whole Lotus army!
But we'll need to find more food in order to forge more armor.
Damn, it's more of that noxious gas…we'll need to blaze a trail with fire.
I don't see a lever anywhere…we'll need a Digger to tunnel under this barrier.
We've spent seven years in these mines.
No matter what happens, we will never wear chains again!
We shouldn't give our Diggers Shale Armor…they'll be too bulky to dig!
Not yet, but we have little time…
Even now, Yvaine must be gathering her forces to wipe us out.
Longtooth will bring reinforcements from the other shale mines.
We must reach the signal tower above us.
If our Pitch Slinger climbs that tower, Longtooth will see his flames and head straight for us.
Be careful! We don't have any other way to light the signal fires.
If you're killed by the Lotus, Longtooth will never reach us in time!
That flame should be visible for miles around. Any sign of our allies?
Longtooth has great courage...I knew he wouldn't fail us.
Can you see anything else? We must know what Yvaine is planning.
That's where Yvaine will be…and perhaps our sacred totem, as well.
First we'll head southwest and free the slaves in the town.
The Lotus will seek revenge for our victories -- nobody must be left behind.
Then we'll tear into that fortress and get some answers from Yvaine!
I haven't seen you in the mines, Wolf brother.
You've been hunting the Lotus for all this time? Amazing!
Will you fight with us, and help us restore the Wolf Clan's freedom?
Then you're welcome at my side, friend Wildeye.
Together, we'll show Yvaine the Wolf's vengeance!
I can see the control lever from here, but only Longtooth could hit it from this distance!
Yvaine has sealed the mountain pass to slow us down…we'll need blunt weapons to break through.
With blunt weapons, we could shatter this rockfall and take Yvaine by surprise!
Enough. Your evil ends here.
No more riddles! What are you doing with the Skull?
Nice throw, old friend!
Our Pitch Slinger should climb this tower and signal to Longtooth…
Without the Pitch Slinger's fires, we can't give Longtooth the signal!
What's going on here?
Lead us there immediately.
We'll defeat these murderous Witches and rescue Gaihla!
You must be Utara.
Gaihla's still alive? Where are you keeping her?
I'll ask you one more time -- where is Gaihla imprisoned?
If you help us find her, I'll let you go.
You disgust me. Get out of my sight.
Wildeye, can you find this laboratory?
The Forest Temple has been destroyed…we've failed to protect the Druidess Order.
What? I didn't understand a word of that!
Do you think she's been murdered?
Then we've got to keep searching.
I'll head this way…you two keep scouting in the other direction.
Be careful!
Need a hand, Wildeye?
Sorry to keep you waiting.
You weren't going to run from those things, were you?
Let's get to a safer place. We have much to discuss.
That monster sacrificed himself for us…
We'll take him to our Keep, and try to revive him.
The lake shore is just a little farther. Wildeye's meeting us there.
I know.
Yvaine's blizzard is killing the land. As the land dies, so does Gaihla.
Have you found any shelter nearby?
In other words, it's a trap.
We don't have much of a choice…let's check it out.
Wildeye, take Gaihla around the south side of the lake, where it's safer.
I'll scout out the main road and meet you at the Monastery.
So you're behind this silly ambush.
Who are you? You're not dressed like a Monk.
Tao, will you help us destroy Yvaine?
We've opened the gates! Rally to me, Wolves!
That should take care of one of the barriers…
The last barrier should be down -- let's move!
Taro, this blizzard is Yvaine's sorcery -- we're also here to stop it.
He's a pompous brat, but we shouldn't kill him -- his father is too powerful.
I suppose there's no other way around the fool.
When we've dealt with his Guardians, the Prince will listen more carefully!
You're not dead yet.
Go home to your father. Tell him the Wolf Clan didn't cause this blizzard.
Let me put it this way: if I wanted war with the Serpent Empire, I'd kill you now.
All I want is to settle our business with Yvaine before we all freeze to death.
Why not let us pass, and tell your father that you stopped the blizzard yourself?
Then you can tell Lord Oja that you slew the evil Wolf rebels single-handedly.
If your brother has any wits at all, he'll outlive you, little Prince.
That's one less den of snakes to trouble us.
We'd better find the last Academy…Taro will discover our handiwork soon.
I'm sure Yvaine knows that we've beaten Issyl, Koril and Taro.
She'll be gathering her powers for the final battle.
Either Yvaine or the Lord of the Wolves must die today.
They'll fall when her towns are destroyed. She can't power them alone.
Not if she intends to keep up this storm, as well.
Even gods can die. Come on, we have work to do.
You are...I'm going down there alone.
I don't know if we can beat Yvaine -- not when she's using that totem.
If I can win this fight, I will.
If I am fated to die, you two must survive to rule the Wolves.
Between your instincts and Longtooth's wits, I'm sure our Clan will survive.
I'll try.
We've disabled the first set of barriers…
We must press our attack to the towns above!
Another of Yvaine's barriers has fallen.
That should take care of another barrier.
We've opened a path to Yvaine's fortress! We must hurry!
All right, Yvaine…where are you hiding?
The enslavement, the war, the winter…all of your evils are about to end.
Safety isn't freedom.
What happened to you?

Killing you will be an act of mercy.
What, and disobey my orders?
You still have a lot to learn, my friend!
Thank you for believing in me.
When Yvaine died, she unleashed the full power of the White Wolf's Skull.
I thought the explosion would destroy us both, but I didn't feel any pain at all.
Yvaine and the corrupted totem are nothing but ashes now.
It was not my destiny to die today.
When he does, the Wolves will be ready for him.
Mmm…rice.
Long ago, life was better for the Wolf Clan.
Our ancestors lived on a faraway island, in peace and harmony.
They took care of the land, and the land gave them everything they needed.
Everything was simple and good…
…until the storms came, and drowned our paradise.
Our ancestors' simple magic was powerless to stop the destruction.
They knew only that they had to flee…or perish.
They never understood the disaster that almost destroyed them.
Half a world away, the Serpent Clan's founder used his Orb to reshape the world.
That act of desperation disrupted the balance of nature, and doomed our home.
But how could our forefathers have imagined the source of their troubles?
And how could they guess where their desperate prayers would take them?
Using our clan's most sacred totem, the White Wolf's Skull, our Druidess Order rescued us from death.
The totem brought us here, to the lands of the Serpent Empire.
Thankful for our salvation, we rebuilt our towns and our lives.
Our new neighbors, the devious Serpent and cold-hearted Lotus, welcomed us as allies and promised us safety.
Unfortunately, we trusted them.
For generations, our Clan tried to return to the simple life it left behind.
Our numbers slowly recovered, and our villages grew and thrived.
Everything seemed simple and good again…
Until a new disaster broke over our people -- a disaster of betrayal and fire.
Lord Zymeth of the Lotus Clan made a deal with the treacherous Serpent emperor, and attacked us by surprise.
The Serpent looked the other way as the Lotus slaughtered our farmers and burned our homes.
Like the rest of my brothers, I fought to save our Clan, and I could not.
The survivors of that battle have been slaves in the Lotus shale mines ever since.
For seven years, we've worked and died to make the Lotus wealthy.
The Lotus slavemaster, Mistress Yvaine, rules our Clan through fear.
She believes we have lost the ability to dream of freedom.
She is wrong.
I am Grayback, last heir to the Wolf Clan's throne.
For seven years, I've trained my fellow miners in the arts of war.
Hammers, picks and stones are our weapons…those, and our unending anger.
A third disaster is coming -- a disaster for the murderers who dared to cross us.
Soon, the Wolf Clan will rise again.
It is the Skull of the White Wolf -- a relic of our clan's guardian spirit.
Until our war against the Lotus, it was our greatest treasure.
Only Gaihla and her Druidess Order knew how to harness its powers.
If they were alive, maybe they could tell us how to stop the Totem.
But they died in the final battle.
How can that be?
Then we must find her.
Gather the troops -- we're leaving at once.
Another brave man has fallen.
I hope he finds freedom.
You're right…we'd better keep moving.
Any enemy of the Lotus is welcome in my camp.
The Shale Lord fights with us.
Then I'll take the Skull of the White Wolf from her.
Yvaine will expect me…I won't ask any of you to follow me into her traps.
You don't have to call me that…
Thank you, my friends.
Can anyone hear me? Help!
Yvaine's had me locked in this stinking cell for days.
A few more seconds and I would've been torn to shreds!
You can count on me always, my Lord!
We've beaten her, Lord!
We've almost reached the main tunnels, Grayback.
Watch out -- I've seen that gas before.
It seeps up from the rocks, and can kill a man in seconds.
What's worse, it's explosive.
Over here, Grayback!
What's behind this barrier?
We can't give up…there must be a way around this barrier.
Daylight! It's been so long…
But that's suicidal!
You'll never beat Yvaine by yourself!
And if we return to find you dead…
The other mines will be free before the Lotus know what hit them.
I won't let you down!
Fight like the Wolf!
Looks like there's some kind of commotion in the town…
The Serpent Witches are famous practitioners of black magic.
I'm not surprised they're doing Yvaine's dirty work.
Looks like the end of the road.
Looks like she's set up plenty of those magic walls to slow us down.
She wields the powers of a god…I don't think it'll be that easy.
I thought I was finished with filthy, Lotus-smelling caves.
Are you insane?
You want me to share a throne with this maniac?
You'd better come back alive, Grayback.
Wait…are those Serpent troops at the bottom of the mountain?
More Serpent troops are climbing the mountain! We must reach Yvaine!
I'm telling you, Grayback's in trouble!
We've got to go after him!
But he can't do this alone! He needs us!
They don't have to be his last orders!
I'm not waiting any longer…
Grayback! Noooooo…!
…I guess he didn't need us after all…
So is our leader.
I should have gone after him…
He's alive! Grayback is alive!
I knew you'd make it, Lord!
He won't try soon! We must have slain half his army on this mountain.
All hail Lord Grayback!
The Totem must be very powerful to create such a storm.
What is it, anyway?
Do you think Gaihla could help us, Wildeye?
If Gaihla can't stop this storm, we'll join him soon enough.
Yes, but can we trust what he's become?
What do you think, Grayback?
Gaihla, the weather is getting worse.
Can you help us stop Yvaine's winter?
Why would any of us abandon you now, Lord Grayback?
There's no way we can fight off an army!
But how will he find us?
(wild cheering)
So cold…
I'm sorry, Grayback, but you'll never win against the Lotus.
You offer us nothing but death…and Budo offered us food.
Please don't take me back to the cage!
It's our leader! Thanks, Grayback!
Grayback, we thought you were dead!
We're too few in number!
No problem, boss!
Wait…there's someone approaching from the East…
Yes, it's Longtooth! And there's a whole army of Wolves behind him!
There's a small town in the southwest…I see slaves in the fields.
And there's a great fortress in the southeast, blocking a pass through the mountains.
(angry bellowing)
I'm so hungry…
Since Budo started ordering us around, I've hardly eaten a thing!
Do you think Mistress Yvaine is starting to trust us, Grayback?
Ha! Fighting's the easiest thing in the world!
It's pretending to be weak that's driving me crazy!
Yeah, but what about our dinner?
I'm starving!
What about my dinner?
I can't! I'm so hungry, I'm about to fall over!
Look at this, Grayback! It's amazing!
What is it?
It's Mistress Yvaine!
Don't hurt us! Budo told us there was shale down here!
We didn't touch your magic stuff...promise!
This isn't an ordinary punishment, Grayback!
I have a bad feeling about this…
Grayback, it's a trap!
Right behind you, boss!
Grayback's come for us! Hooray!
We heard fighting, but we couldn't open the gate!
The Lotus have a bunch of these rice bins stashed down here.
Free us, and we'll bust 'em open for you!
So the trappers were trapped, and the murderers slain!
Congratulations, Grayback, on a battle well fought!

I am both Monk and Ninja. Half Light, half Darkness.
I serve Yin and Yang, and the Balance of all things.

By protecting this Monastery, I strengthen the Yang and serve the Balance.

I think I protected them very well!
Correction -- only half mad.

Listen closely, and I will give you the secrets you need…

Now, I must depart. The Balance calls me to other lands.
Fight well, Grayback! We both have unfinished duties in this world!
Now I'll never avenge my murdered family…
Pain, eh? I could show you a thing or two about that…

I'm a Wolf, all right, but I've never been in those stinking mines.
My allies in the forest kept me well-hidden after the war.
The Lotus destroyed my family and my home, but they couldn't catch Wildeye!
I've been stalking and killing those devils ever since.
Are you kidding? I've waited seven years to hear those words!

Seven years ago, you murdered my mate and my cubs.
But you wouldn't remember that, would you?

Cutting her open?

…I wonder what Utara meant by 'abominations'…?

No, the wolves would smell her blood.

Huh? Where did this Wolf Clansman come from?

I'd better stalk these two and see if they lead me to Gaihla.
Can't let them see me, or I'll never find out where they're heading!
Curses…we've lost them! Now we'll never find Gaihla!

I'll bet my mustache that Gaihla's down there somewhere.

He'll know what to do.
Huh? What's wrong?

Gah! We've been surrounded by more of those disgusting monsters!

Of course not!

Lady Gaihla? Are you all right?

I bet that pansy would run screaming from a real fight.

If we destroy all three Academies, Taro will know we mean business.

We're not magicians, we're miners, you dolt!
Let's finish this.
By all the gods, it's cold! I can't even feel my mustache!

We are not leaving you now!
Us? Rulers? You are insane.
Hope he knows what he's doing…
Gaihla is right, my friend.
We must not dishonor Grayback's last orders.
Look! The snow is stopping!
What was that blast? We thought you were a goner!
And the other half can wait until Spring!
All hail the Lord of the Wolves!

I don't mind a little snow, but this stuff is cold as death!
Ha ha! You're not the first to think so!

Gaihla is alive, and her Druidesses, too!
The woods-walkers have ways of hiding from their enemies.
They're still living in the old swamps, waiting for us to return.
She knows more of the ancient ways than any living Wolf.
If Gaihla can't figure out how to stop this nasty weather, nobody can.
He fights like a behemoth! I say we're lucky he's on our side.
That black-hearted sorceress still owes me a debt of blood. I'm coming.
Gaihla's right. We're your pack.
And we'll fight by your side until the end.
